simple.prompt: Look at those dark storm clouds! It ___ rain very soon.
simple.explanation: Ketika ada bukti fisik nyata yang terlihat saat ini (present evidence seperti awan gelap), gunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi: 'It is going to rain'.
hints: Ada bukti fisik yang jelas terlihat di depan mata.
Gunakan 'be going to' untuk prediksi berbasis bukti nyata.

simple.prompt: The telephone is ringing! — Don't worry, I ___ answer it.
simple.explanation: Keputusan spontan yang dibuat pada saat berbicara (spontaneous on-the-spot decision) menggunakan modal 'will': 'I will answer it'.
hints: Keputusan mendadak dibuat seketika saat itu juga.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat rencana masa depan yang sudah diniatkan (prior intention).
simple.targetSentence: We are going to launch the website next week.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + are going to + base verb (launch) + the website + next week.
hints: Rencana yang sudah diniatkan sebelum berbicara.

simple.prompt: I promise I ___ reveal your confidential project details to anyone.
simple.explanation: Janji (promises), tawaran (offers), dan ancaman (threats) menggunakan modal 'will' atau bentuk negatifnya 'won't'.

simple.targetSentence: I will carry those heavy boxes for you.
simple.explanation: Tawaran bantuan spontan: I will + carry + those heavy boxes + for you.

simple.prompt: She has already bought her flight tickets; she ___ spend her vacation in Bali.
simple.explanation: Karena tiket sudah dibeli (ada persiapan dan rencana matang), gunakan 'be going to': 'is going to spend'.
hints: Rencana yang sudah dipersiapkan dan diniatkan sebelumnya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat tanya rencana dengan 'Are you going to'.
simple.targetSentence: Are you going to attend the seminar tomorrow?
simple.explanation: Are you going to + base verb (attend) + the seminar + tomorrow?

simple.prompt: Watch out! That loaded pallet is leaning sharply — it ___ tip over!
simple.explanation: Prediksi masa depan berdasarkan bukti fisik yang sudah tampak jelas di depan mata ('leaning sharply') menggunakan 'be going to'.
hints: Ada bukti nyata yang terlihat sekarang (palet miring tajam).
Prediksi berbasis bukti langsung memakai 'going to'.

simple.prompt: Oh no, the coffee machine is out of paper filters! Don't worry, I ___ buy a pack downstairs.
simple.explanation: Keputusan spontan yang baru saja diambil saat berbicara ('Don't worry, I...') menggunakan 'will'.
hints: Ini reaksi langsung spontan saat mendengar masalah.

simple.prompt: Our family ___ visit Kyoto next spring; we already booked the flights.
simple.explanation: Rencana matang yang sudah diputuskan dan disiapkan sebelum berbicara ('already booked the flights') memakai 'be going to'.
hints: Rencana yang sudah matang memakai 'is going to'.

simple.prompt: I promise I ___ send you the signed consent form tonight.
simple.explanation: Janji pribadi ('I promise...') secara alami dinyatakan menggunakan 'will'.

dialogue: Visitor
These archive boxes look terribly heavy!
Guard
Hold on — I ___ help you carry them to the elevator.
simple.explanation: Menawarkan bantuan secara langsung saat melihat seseorang kesulitan selalu memakai 'will'.

simple.prompt: ___ your team going to launch the mobile app next Friday?
simple.explanation: Pola tanya 'be going to' untuk subjek tunggal 'your team' dimulai dengan to be 'Is' (bukan 'Will').
hints: Struktur 'be + S + going to' memakai to be 'Is'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk kata kerja setelah modal 'will' berikut.
simple.draft: Our marketing agency will launches the regional ad campaign next week.
options: Our marketing agency will launch the regional ad campaign next week.
Our marketing agency will launched the regional ad campaign next week.
Our marketing agency is will launch the regional ad campaign next week.
simple.explanation: Setelah modal auxiliary 'will', verb wajib berbentuk dasar murni (bare infinitive) 'launch' tanpa akhiran -es/-s.

simple.prompt: Notice the luggage tags! Are they ___ fly to Perth tonight?
simple.explanation: Dengan 'Are they...' di depan, lengkapi konstruksi dengan 'going to' sebelum verb 'fly'.
hints: Sudah ada to be 'Are' di depan.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat rencana terstruktur memakai 'going to'.
simple.targetSentence: We are going to renovate the clinic lobby next month.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + are going to + V1 (renovate) + object + time.

simple.targetSentence: She will call us as soon as she reaches the hotel.
simple.explanation: Promise/future statement: Subject + will + V1 + object + time clause.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di restoran yang menunjukkan keputusan spontan.
dialogue: Waiter
Are you ready to order, sir?
Customer
Yes, I ___ have the grilled salmon and a sparkling water, please.
intermediate.explanation: Pemesanan makanan di restoran adalah keputusan spontan saat membaca menu, sehingga menggunakan 'will': 'I will have...'.

intermediate.prompt: In my opinion, renewable energy ___ replace fossil fuels within the next two decades.
intermediate.explanation: Prediksi berdasarkan opini pribadi atau keyakinan subjektif (personal belief/opinion setelah 'In my opinion' atau 'I think') biasanya memakai 'will'.
hints: Prediksi berbasis opini atau keyakinan subjektif.

intermediate.prompt: Watch out! That unstable stack of crates ___ topple over!
intermediate.explanation: Peringatan darurat berdasarkan kejadian fisik yang sedang berlangsung saat itu (immediate visible evidence) menggunakan 'is going to'.
hints: Tanda-tanda fisik sudah terlihat bergoyang mau jatuh.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat janji formal dengan 'will never'.
intermediate.targetSentence: We will never compromise on data security.
intermediate.explanation: Janji formal: We will never + compromise on + data security.

intermediate.prompt: ___ we organize a farewell dinner for the departing project manager?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris baku, 'Shall I / Shall we...?' digunakan untuk menawarkan saran atau usulan sopan (suggestions/offers with I/we).
hints: Saran atau tawaran sopan dengan subjek 'we'.

intermediate.targetSentence: The printer won't print this document.
intermediate.explanation: 'Won't' dapat digunakan untuk benda yang menolak berfungsi (refusal of an object): 'The car won't start / The printer won't print'.

intermediate.prompt: Pilih bentuk rencana terkonfirmasi vs keputusan seketika.
dialogue: Manager
Why are you packing up your files?
Staff
Because I ___ clean out my desk before relocating tomorrow.
intermediate.explanation: Rencana yang sudah diniatkan sebelum ditanya (prior plan/intention) menggunakan 'am going to clean'.

intermediate.prompt: The stubborn lock simply ___ open, no matter how hard I turn the key!
intermediate.explanation: 'Won't' sering dipakai untuk menyatakan penolakan atau benda mati yang 'membandel' tidak mau berfungsi.

intermediate.prompt: ___ I open the window so we get some fresh air in this meeting room?
intermediate.explanation: Dalam kalimat tanya penawaran sopan dengan subjek 'I' atau 'we', 'Shall I / Shall we...?' adalah bentuk baku dan natural.
hints: Subjeknya 'I' dalam kalimat tanya penawaran bantuan.
Pasangkan 'Shall I...?' untuk tawaran atau usulan sopan.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di meja tiket mengenai jadwal keberangkatan tetap.
dialogue: Tourist
What time are you going to get to the terminal?
Driver
Around seven. Remember, the ferry ___ at 7:45 sharp.
intermediate.explanation: Jadwal resmi transportasi publik tetap memakai Present Simple ('leaves'), bukan bentuk future 'going/will' berantakan.
hints: Ferry memiliki jadwal resmi tetap setiap hari.

intermediate.prompt: After the auditor ___ the final spreadsheet, we will submit the report to headquarters.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam time clause masa depan setelah 'after', 'when', atau 'as soon as', JANGAN memakai 'will'; gunakan Present Simple ('approves').
hints: Klausa waktu masa depan memakai Present Simple.

intermediate.prompt: I don't think the new policy ___ take effect before January.
intermediate.explanation: Karena kalimat sudah bermakna negatif di depan ('I don't think...'), hindari negatif ganda ('won't'); cukup gunakan 'will'.
hints: Sudah ada penegas negatif 'don't think' di klausa pertama.

intermediate.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda pemakaian 'will' di dalam klausa 'when' berikut.
intermediate.draft: We will celebrate with the whole team when the contract will be finalized tomorrow.
options: We will celebrate with the whole team when the contract is finalized tomorrow.
We celebrate with the whole team when the contract will be finalized tomorrow.
We will celebrated with the whole team when the contract is finalized tomorrow.
intermediate.explanation: Pada future time clause setelah 'when', gunakan Present Simple ('is finalized'), sementara klausa utama tetap memakai 'will celebrate'.
hints: Hapus 'will' di klausa 'when' dan ubah ke Present Simple.

intermediate.prompt: Wait! Look at that stack of glasses near the edge — it ___ fall!
intermediate.explanation: Bahaya atau peristiwa yang hampir pasti terjadi dalam hitungan detik berdasarkan kondisi visual langsung memakai 'is going to'.
hints: Situasinya terlihat jelas tumpukan itu miring di tepi meja.
Prediksi berdasar bukti saat ini memakai 'is going to'.

intermediate.prompt: If the shipment arrives early tomorrow, the warehouse crew ___ unload it immediately.
intermediate.explanation: First conditional untuk akibat masa depan memakai 'will' + V1 pada klausa utama.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat penawaran usulan dengan 'Shall we'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Shall we invite the regional coordinator to Friday's review?
intermediate.explanation: Usulan bersama dengan subjek 'we' memakai struktur tanya 'Shall we + V1...?'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat ber-time clause dengan 'until' (tanpa 'will' di klausa waktu).
intermediate.targetSentence: Please hold the invoice until the manager signs the form.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa waktu setelah 'until' menggunakan Present Simple ('signs') untuk merujuk masa depan.
hints: Lanjutkan 'until the manager signs the form'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penggunaan 'will' di dalam klausa waktu (time clause).
complex.draft: As soon as the client will arrive, we will start the product walkthrough.
options: As soon as the client arrives, we will start the product walkthrough.
As soon as the client is arriving, we will start the product walkthrough.
As soon as the client arrived, we will start the product walkthrough.
complex.explanation: Di dalam klausa waktu yang diawali konjungsi seperti 'as soon as', 'when', 'before', 'after', atau 'until', TIDAK boleh menggunakan 'will'. Wajib menggunakan Present Simple ('arrives') untuk menyatakan waktu masa depan.
hints: Klausa waktu (as soon as, when, before) tidak boleh memakai 'will'.
Gunakan Present Simple di dalam klausa waktunya.

complex.prompt: If the audit team ___ any irregularities, they will notify executive management immediately.
complex.explanation: Dalam First Conditional (If-clause), klausa 'if' menggunakan Present Simple ('discovers'), bukan 'will'.

complex.prompt: The train ___ at precisely 08:45 tomorrow morning according to the official timetable.
complex.explanation: Untuk jadwal transportasi umum atau agenda resmi yang sudah tertera di jadwal tetap (timetables/schedules), bahasa Inggris formal menggunakan Present Simple ('departs'), bukan 'will'.
hints: Jadwal transportasi resmi menggunakan Present Simple.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat klausa waktu masa depan dengan konjungsi 'until'.
complex.targetSentence: We will wait here until you return.
complex.explanation: Main clause (We will wait here) + Time clause (until you return). Di klausa 'until' gunakan Present Simple 'return'.
hints: Main clause memakai 'We will wait here'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kerancuan penggunaan modal masa depan pada klausa 'unless'.
complex.draft: We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor will agree to the terms.
options: We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor agrees to the terms.
We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor is agreeing to the terms.
We cannot finalize the deal unless the vendor will be agreeing to the terms.
complex.explanation: Sama seperti 'if', konjungsi syarat 'unless' (jika tidak) tidak boleh diikuti 'will'. Gunakan Present Simple: 'unless the vendor agrees'.
hints: Gunakan Present Simple: 'unless the vendor agrees'.

complex.prompt: The international trade conference ___ take place next October in Singapore.
complex.explanation: Struktur formal resmi 'be to + infinitive' ('is to take place') digunakan dalam konteks berita, diplomatik, atau instruksi resmi untuk peristiwa masa depan yang sudah dijadwalkan secara kenegaraan/resmi.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan janji bersyarat yang gramatikal.
dialogue: Supplier
When can we expect the milestone payment?
Buyer
We will issue the disbursement the moment the shipment ___ our warehouse.
complex.explanation: Frasa waktu 'the moment...' berfungsi sebagai konjungsi waktu (seperti as soon as), sehingga klausa berikutnya harus menggunakan Present Simple: 'reaches'.
hints: 'The moment' adalah konjungsi waktu penanda saat.

complex.prompt: The Prime Minister ___ open the regional infrastructure summit in Surabaya next Thursday.
complex.explanation: Struktur formal berita dan pengumuman resmi kenegaraan menggunakan 'be + to + infinitive' ('is to open') untuk agenda yang telah ditetapkan secara resmi.
hints: Perhatikan gaya bahasa berita resmi tingkat tinggi.
Konstruksi formal jadwal resmi adalah 'is to + V1'.

complex.prompt: According to the strict lease terms, all tenants ___ vacate the annex by September 30.
complex.explanation: Kewajiban resmi atau aturan tertulis formal sering diungkapkan dengan pola 'be to + infinitive' ('are to vacate').

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum campuran future form pada kalimat pengumuman formal berikut.
complex.draft: All department heads are going deliver their annual audits before the board meets on May 12.
options: All department heads are to deliver their annual audits before the board meets on May 12.
All department heads are to delivering their annual audits before the board meets on May 12.
All department heads will to deliver their annual audits before the board meets on May 12.
complex.explanation: 'Are going' tanpa 'to' salah, dan dalam konteks instruksi resmi agenda dewan direksi, 'are to deliver' sangat presisi dan ringkas (perhatikan 'are to + V1' dasar).
hints: Hilangnya 'to' membuat 'are going deliver' tidak gramatikal.
Pola formal instruksi resmi adalah 'are to + bare infinitive'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan hukum mengenai modalitas kewajiban 'shall' dalam kontrak formal.
dialogue: Legal Counsel
Under Clause 9, what happens if either party delays payment past thirty days?
Partner
The clause states clearly that the defaulting party ___ incur a monthly late fee.
complex.explanation: Dalam naskah hukum, peraturan, dan kontrak formal, 'shall' dengan subjek orang ketiga menyatakan kewajiban mengikat secara hukum ('wajib/harus').
hints: Di ragam hukum, 'shall' bermakna kewajiban resmi.

complex.prompt: By the time the courier reaches the customs desk, the new tariff rules ___ already in force.
complex.explanation: 'Will be' menyatakan keadaan pasti pada satu titik waktu di masa depan ('By the time...').

complex.prompt: Should you decide to extend your stay, the front desk ___ happy to adjust your booking.
complex.explanation: Klausa inversi conditional tipe 1 ('Should you decide...') berpasangan dengan 'will + V1' di klausa utama.
hints: 'Should you decide' setara dengan 'If you decide'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan makna bukti vs keputusan spontan pada kalimat laporan bisnis berikut.
complex.draft: Wait, we forgot to reserve a projector! — Look at the email, I will reserve it an hour ago.
options: Wait, we forgot to reserve a projector! — Don't panic, I will call IT and reserve one right now.
Wait, we forgot to reserve a projector! — Look at the email, I am going to reserved it an hour ago.
Wait, we forgot to reserve a projector! — Don't panic, I am going reserve one right now.
complex.explanation: Respon terhadap masalah yang baru disadari ('Don't panic...') tidak mungkin memakai 'will + an hour ago'; keputusan spontan saat ini memakai 'I will call... right now'.
hints: 'Will' hanya untuk masa depan atau keputusan saat ini.
Perbaiki ketidakcocokan keterangan waktu 'an hour ago'.

complex.prompt: Our R&D unit is on the verge of completing the battery prototype, which ___ double electric range.
complex.explanation: Untuk prediksi formal yang objektif dan terukur dalam laporan teknik, gunakan 'is expected to + V1' daripada bentuk salah 'will going to'.
hints: Bentuk 'will going to' dan 'shall to' tidak gramatikal.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat instruksi resmi berpola 'be to + infinitive'.
complex.targetSentence: All security guards are to inspect visitor badges at the gate.
complex.explanation: 'Subject + are to + V1' menyatakan prosedur wajib atau instruksi resmi.
hints: Mulai dengan 'All security guards are to'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian formal dengan 'provided that' tanpa 'will' di anak kalimat.
complex.targetSentence: We will sign the lease provided that the landlord repairs the roof.
complex.explanation: Setelah 'provided that' (syarat masa depan), gunakan Present Simple ('repairs'), bukan 'will repair'.
hints: Awali dengan klausa hasil 'We will sign the lease'.
Lanjutkan dengan syarat Present Simple 'provided that the landlord repairs...'.
